transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah, good to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I've just been beating myself up a lot lately. Mostly about work. I just... I keep thinking I'm not really senior material. Like maybe I just fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
Did something specific happen at work that started these thoughts about not being senior material?

Um... I guess. About a month ago, they asked me to cover the senior analyst duties for a bit. And... well, that's when I really started noticing this up-and-down pattern with how I've been feeling. So... yeah, it was about a month ago.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah... I guess so. Most days lately, it's just... I don't know, this heavy, low feeling. Like I'm just kind of moving through work and home, but... everything just sort of has the color turned down. So... yeah.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... normally I look forward to grilling on the weekend, or... maybe going fishing. Putting on a record. But lately... I don't know. I just leave the stuff sitting there. I don't really care much about doing any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this low most days?

Um... I don't know exactly. If I really think about it... these low stretches, where I just feel guilty and heavy... they've kind of been coming and going for a while. Maybe... almost a year? Like eleven months or so.
Before this current low stretch, have you had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really kept track of it. Maybe? I just... I don't remember if it was ever two weeks straight before this.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to do your job?

I mean... I'm still making it in to the office. It's just... I guess I've had to double-check my work a lot more lately. Just to be sure. And... I don't know, I guess I've kind of pulled back from seeing people. Friends, family... I just don't really trust where my head's at right now, so it's easier to just stay away.
Do you feel these mood changes mostly happen because of the work situation?
I don't... I'm not sure. Work is just work. I don't really know why I feel like this. It just... happens, I guess.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Um... no, I haven't made any plans to hurt myself or anything like that. I just... I don't know. I guess I do catch myself thinking sometimes that... it might just be easier if I didn't wake up some morning. But I wouldn't actually do anything.
Thinking back over the past year, was there a time when your mood returned to normal for at least two months before getting low again?

I... I don't really know. It's hard to keep track of it all. I guess... maybe? I'm not really sure if there was a full two months where things felt completely normal. It all just kind of blends together after a while.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, not just work?
Um... no. Not really. Just the usual stuff, I guess. I don't think I worry more than anybody else. Just... normal things.
Have you noticed a change in your sleep lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I'll wake up way too early, thinking about client tickets and stuff, and then I can't get back to sleep. Or... even if I do manage to sleep enough hours, I still just feel totally worn out anyway. So... yeah.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I just haven't really been eating much. I might grab a few bites of something here and there, or just skip supper entirely. I don't know... I guess my belt feels a little looser lately, but I'm not, like, trying to lose weight or anything. It's just... off.
Before this current stretch, was there ever another time in your life when you felt depressed like this nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, maybe a bad day here or there, but... nothing that lasted that long. Just this time, I guess.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
Um... not really, no. I mean, I can still focus on work stuff fine, I guess. I haven't really noticed any big problems with that. Just... normal, I suppose.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I mean, nobody's said anything to me about it. Just... moving normal, I guess.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Um... I don't know about the word worthless, but... I guess I've been pretty hard on myself lately. That's actually kind of why I came in. I just... I keep beating myself up, thinking I'm not really senior material at work. Like maybe I just... fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. So... yeah. I guess so.
During this current stretch, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Um... yeah, I suppose. It's just... most days lately I've had this heavy, low feeling. Like I'm just moving through work and home with the color turned down, I guess. It's been going on for a bit now.
Because of how you've been feeling, have you missed work or been unable to do your usual responsibilities?

Um... no, I haven't missed work. I'm still going. Just... I guess I've had to double-check my work a lot more than usual. And... well, I haven't really been seeing friends or family much. I just... I don't really trust my mood right now, or my judgment, so I've just been keeping to myself. But I'm still doing my job.
Have you felt down or depressed more days than not for at least the past two years?
No, not for that long. It's just... recently.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient meets criteria for a current depressive episode with depressed mood, anhedonia, early-morning awakening/fatigue, reduced appetite/possible weight loss, excessive self-criticism/guilt-worthlessness, and passive thoughts of death, present nearly every day for at least two weeks. There is functional impact through social withdrawal and increased effort at work. The syndrome is more specific than unspecified depressive episode, and severity is best supported as moderate rather than unspecified.
